key_idea: Since difficulties are a permutation, k works iff every position i holds a value from the same block: (d_i-1)/(n/k) == i/(n/k).
sketch: For each divisor k>1 of n, with block size s=n/k, check that all 0-indexed positions i satisfy (d_i-1)/s == i/s; print valid k in increasing order or -1. O(n * divisors). Pitfall: k=n (fully sorted) is allowed, k=1 is not.
